description: List the newest invoices of the connected facturo account with status (open, overdue, paid, cancelled with the Storno in cancelled_by, issued for a Storno or Gutschrift), totals, items, VAT mode, PDF links and when they were last emailed. Filter by client, text or status. Use it to answer 'what did I bill Huber' or 'what is still open', and to copy an earlier invoice ('the same as last time'): take items, vat_exemption_type, vat_rate, prices_include_vat and the discount fields from the row. The PDF links are for the user to open.

search.description: Matches invoice number, client name, reference lines or an item description
